rules.name: Pass-the-Hash Detection
rules.description: Detects NTLM pass-the-hash attacks where an adversary uses a password hash instead of plaintext password
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("pass-the-hash" OR "windows")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Pass-the-Ticket (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket reuse across systems indicating pass-the-ticket attacks
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("pass-the-ticket" OR "kerberos")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: RDP Anomalous Connection
rules.description: Detects anomalous RDP connections including unusual source IPs, off-hours access, or lateral movement patterns
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("rdp" OR "remote-desktop")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: SSH Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects SSH connections from compromised hosts to internal systems indicating lateral movement
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("ssh" OR "remote-access")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: WMI/PSExec Remote Execution
rules.description: Detects remote execution via WMI, PSExec, or similar tools indicating lateral movement
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("wmi" OR "psexec" OR "remote-execution")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: SMB Lateral Movement via Admin Shares
rules.description: Detects lateral movement through SMB admin shares (C$, ADMIN$) for remote execution
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("smb" OR "admin-shares" OR "windows")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: DCOM Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects DCOM-based lateral movement through distributed COM object activation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("dcom" OR "distributed-com")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: WinRM Remote Shell Access
rules.description: Detects Windows Remote Management shell access for lateral movement and remote execution
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("winrm" OR "remote-shell")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Golden Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Golden Ticket attacks where forged TGTs grant persistent domain access
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("golden-ticket" OR "kerberos" OR "persistence")
author: SIEM Alert Rules

rules.name: Silver Ticket Attack (Kerberos)
rules.description: Detects Kerberos Silver Ticket attacks using forged service tickets for targeted service access
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("silver-ticket" OR "kerberos" OR "privilege-escalation")
author: SIEM Alert Rules
